name: The Open Door
poem: and let the true path show
story: An opportunity is closer than it appears.
interpretation: Choose a small action today instead of waiting for perfect certainty.

name: The Still Lake
poem: the depth holds what is true
interpretation: Pause before reacting and listen to what remains after the noise.

name: The Lantern
interpretation: Ask for help or offer it; collaboration will reveal the next step.

name: The Mountain Pass
poem: The high road asks for patience
the steep road asks for care
story: Progress is possible but not immediate.
interpretation: Reduce the risk, plan the climb and refuse unnecessary shortcuts.

name: The Seed
poem: A seed does not look like harvest
until roots are strong and sound
interpretation: Keep nurturing the plan even when results are not visible yet.

name: The Returning Tide
poem: meet it with a wiser heart
and do not repeat the same
story: A second chance may carry a lesson.
interpretation: Revisit the opportunity only after changing the pattern that failed before.
